eps.o: In the wake of their climactic escape from Dennison, our crew searches for a way to end the Institute for good. The Director enlists a new ally to help him rebuild. Sigsby’s life as a fugitive pushes her to seek a way back “in.” Luke's power grows.

In the wake of tragedy, the crew is on the run once again. Meanwhile, the Institute struggles to pick up the pieces after a setback. Desperate to keep his friends safe, Luke makes a terrible choice that may end up costing him everything he holds dear.
Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.
